newsitem.title: FRANCE: Plastic Omnium up on H2 outlook.
newsitem.headline: Plastic Omnium up on H2 outlook.

text.p: Shares in car parts manufacturer Plastic Omnium rose sharply on the Paris bourse after company officials said the improvement in its first-half results was expected for the full year.
The company also said full-year sales were expected to exceed seven billion francs despite the uncertain prospects for the car industry.

The company announced its first-half profit jumped to 45 million francs from 10 million a year ago and sales rose to 3.8 billion francs from 2.6 billion. The sales increase was due in large part to its recent acquisition of Reydel Industries.
The stock was 30 francs higher at 467 in a generally weak market at 1445 GMT.
